name: inter.face-antigravity-subagents
description: Antigravity subagent definitions for the inter.face design pipeline

subagents.name: direction-conductor
subagents.description: Loop 1 phase agent for inter.face. Runs derivation, per-direction palette and type, concepts and distinctness tests, ACCESS.md §13 decisions, and dispatches surface-designer workers. Returns the assembled Gate A package.

subagents.name: surface-designer
subagents.description: Loop 1 worker for inter.face. Produces ONE comp of ONE surface for ONE concept (coded spec block or image mode). Logs composition anchor and background mode tokens.

subagents.name: craft-conductor
subagents.description: Loop 2 phase agent for inter.face. Assigns a technique per surface against the three-question test, dispatches technique-prototyper workers, writes motion spec and budget tiers, and completes DIRECTION.md plus tokens.json.

subagents.name: technique-prototyper
subagents.description: Loop 2 worker for inter.face. Proves ONE technique before design depends on it — standalone runnable HTML file, screenshot of every state, measured frame rate under load, real byte cost.

subagents.name: system-builder
subagents.description: Loop 3 worker for inter.face. Builds ONE navigable component sheet from tokens.json and DIRECTION.md alone — every component in every state it owes, both colour modes, keyboard-walkable — screenshots it, walks it, and returns gap report.

subagents.name: redesign-scout
subagents.description: Redesign phase agent for inter.face. Runs REDESIGN.md extraction against live rendered surface, writes CURRENT.md, runs absence sweep, positions result against STYLES.md, returns proposed fork.
